text.description_html:
Acorn RICBP, 8-3/4" Rough Iron Dummy Heart Strap Hinges For Interior And Exterior Doors

The 8-3/4 Inch Heart Tip Rough Iron Dummy Strap Hinge grants an old world charm to any home without having to install working hinges. Making this hinge type especially useful where installing a working hinge would be impractical, like on a garage door. It is surface mounted (screwed to the door) with the included matching finish screws. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron.

Also Available Matching:

14" Heart Tip Rough Iron Dummy Strap Hinge
18-3/4" Heart Tip Rough Iron Dummy Strap Hinge
22-1/4" Heart Tip Rough Iron Dummy Strap Hinge
28-3/8" Heart Tip Rough Iron Dummy Strap Hinge

Specifications of the 8-3/4" Rough Iron Heart Tip Dummy Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 8-3/4"
  • Width at Hinge: 1-3/8"
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Sold Individually
